title: Optimized protocol for naive human pluripotent stem cell-derived trophoblast induction
author: Io, Iemura, et al.
materials: Human embryonic stem cell line: H9 (WA09)

Timing: 3 h

Timing: 6 h; 3–6 days until next splitting

This protocol describes the use of primary patient material. Please confirm that you are allowed to process primary patient material with your local Ethics Committee and request informed consent from the donors. Placental tissues should be kept under sterile conditions.48.Prepare Laminin-E8-coated wells beforehand.a.Add 1.5 μg (3 μL) of Laminin-E8 to 1 mL of PBS and pipette up and down several times.b.Add the Laminin-E8/PBS solution to one well of 6-well dishes.c.Incubate at 37°C for at least 30 min.49.Human chorionic villi are manually separated from the chorionic membrane and decidua.50.Cut the chorionic villi into small pieces and transfer to a 50-mL tube.51.Rinse the villous fragments with 40 mL of sterile PBS.52.Centrifuge at 800 rpm (120 g) for 2 min.53.Aspirate most of the supernatant.54.Repeat the rinse procedure. Shake the tube vigorously until the supernatant is clear.55.Digest three times in a solution containing 0.25% Trypsin and 1 mg/mL collagenase IV, 200 U/mL DNase (Sigma-Aldrich), 25 mM HEPES, and DMEM/F-12 medium with agitation at 37°C.56.Filter pooled cell suspensions through a 70-μm mesh filter (Corning) to remove debris and syncytiotrophoblasts.57.Add 30 mL of Wash medium and centrifuge at 1,300 rpm for 3 min.58.Resuspend with 1% BSA/HBSS and incubate on ice for 30 min to reduce the non-specific binding of antibodies.59.Centrifuge at 1,300 rpm for 3 min, aspirate the supernatant, and resuspend the pellet with 1% BSA/HBSS with an Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-TACSTD2 antibody, a PE-conjugated anti-ENPEP antibody, and a biotin-conjugated, anti-SIGLEC6 antibody.60.Incubate at 4°C for 30 min.61.Resuspend with 1 mL of 1% BSA/HBSS.62.Centrifuge at 1,300 rpm for 3 min and aspirate the supernatant.63.Resuspend with 1% BSA/HBSS with anti-Streptavidin, APC-conjugated antibody.64.Incubate at 4°C for 30 min.65.Collect TACSTD2+ENPEP+SIGLEC6+ cells using a cell sorter.Note: Keep the collection medium cool (4°C) during cell sorting to maintain the viability of the cells.Note: Cell sorting should be performed with a sufficiently rigorous selection to obtain high-purity cell fraction.Note: Given the increased risk of microbial contamination during purification step by flow cytometry, collected cells may be fed with ACE medium supplemented with 1% Penicillin-Streptomycin. Antimicrobial-supplemented medium should be used for a minimum of 2 days.66.Centrifuge at 1,300 rpm for 3 min.67.Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend with ACE medium supplemented with 1% Penicillin-Streptomycin.68.Seed the cells at a density of 4 × 104 cells/cm2 on the Laminin-E8-coated wells.69.Replace the medium every two days. The cells are passaged every 3–6 days by dissociation with Accutase for 10–15 min and seeded at a 1:3–1:4 split ratio. 10 μM Y-27632 is added with every passage.Note: If you use fluorescent dye-conjugated antibodies as the primary antibodies, you can omit the secondary antibody reaction.Note: Pacific Blue-conjugated HLA-ABC antibody improves the purity of cytotrophoblasts (TACSTD2+ENPEP+SIGLEC6+HLA-ABC- cells).CRITICAL: To maintain human primary cytotrophoblasts, cells should be sorted from first-trimester placenta. Cytotrophoblasts sorted from full-term placenta cannot be maintained with ACE medium.

steps.title: Prepare stock solution aliquots
steps.instruction: Prepare and aliquot all stock reagents at the concentrations and storage conditions listed in the table, avoiding freeze‑thaw cycles.

substeps.instruction: Trypsin: 2.5% stock (0.025% working), store at –20 °C.
Collagenase IV: 10 mg/mL stock (1 mg/mL working), aliquot in PBS.
Knockout Serum Replacement (KSR): 1:5 working, aliquot directly.
MEM non‑essential amino acids (NEAA): 1:100 working, aliquot directly.
2‑Mercaptoethanol (2ME): 100 mM stock (0.1 mM working), store at 4 °C.
BSA (7.5 % w/v) in D‑PBS: aliquot directly.
Recombinant human bFGF: 10 µg/mL stock (4 ng/mL working), store at –80 °C.
Recombinant human BMP4: 100 µg/mL stock (10 ng/mL working), store at –80 °C.
Recombinant human EGF: 100 µg/mL stock (50 ng/mL working), store at –80 °C.
Recombinant human LIF: 1 µg/mL stock (10 ng/mL working), store at –80 °C.
CHIR99021: 10 mM stock (1 µM or 2 µM working), store at –80 °C.
PD0325901: 10 mM stock (1 µM or 2 µM working), store at –80 °C.
Gö6983: 5 mM stock (2 µM working), store at –80 °C.
Y‑27632: 10 mM stock (10 µM working), store at –80 °C.
A83‑01: 2.5 mM stock (1.2 µM–7.5 µM working), store at –80 °C.
JAK inhibitor I: 10 mM stock (1 µg/mL working), store below –80 °C.
XAV939: 20 mM stock (2 µM working), store at –80 °C.
Valproic acid sodium salt (VPA): 0.3 M stock (1 mM working), filter and aliquot.
NRG1: 100 µg/mL stock (2 µM working) in 20 mM citrate pH 3.0, filter and aliquot.
Forskolin: 100 mM stock (2 µM working), aliquot.

steps.title: Prepare individual reagent aliquots
steps.instruction: Make 10 mL aliquots of Trypsin, KSR, NEAA and 7.5 % BSA; resuspend and filter Collagenase IV to 10 mg/mL; prepare 2ME, bFGF, BMP4, EGF, LIF, CHIR99021, PD0325901, Gö6983, Y‑27632, A83‑01, JAK inhibitor I, XAV939, VPA, NRG1 and Forskolin as described.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend 10 µg bFGF in 10 mL PBS + 0.01 % BSA → 10 µg/mL; aliquot 100 µL, store ≤6 months at –80 °C, then ≤2 weeks at 4 °C after thaw.
Resuspend 10 µg BMP4 in 100 µL 4 mM HCl + 0.1 % BSA → 100 µg/mL; aliquot 10 µL, same storage as bFGF.
Resuspend 200 µg EGF in 1.8 mL PBS + 0.1 % BSA → 100 µg/mL; aliquot 100 µL, store ≤6 months at –80 °C, then ≤2 weeks at –20 °C after thaw.
Resuspend 1 mg LIF in 100 mL PBS + 0.1 % BSA → 1 µg/mL; aliquot 100 µL, store ≤6 months at –80 °C, avoid >1 week at 4 °C.
Resuspend 25 mg CHIR99021 in 5 373 µL DMSO → 10 mM; aliquot 20 µL, store ≤6 months at –80 °C, avoid >1 week at 4 °C.
Resuspend 50 mg PD0325901 in 10 359 µL DMSO → 10 mM; aliquot 20 µL, same storage as CHIR99021.
Resuspend 10 mg Gö6983 in 4 520 µL DMSO → 5 mM; aliquot 50 µL, same storage.
Resuspend 50 mg Y‑27632 in 14.7 mL distilled water → 10 mM; aliquot 100 µL, store ≤6 months at –80 °C, then ≤2 weeks at 4 °C after thaw.
Resuspend 50 mg A83‑01 in 4 740 µL DMSO → 2.5 mM; aliquot 50 µL, same storage.
Resuspend 5 mg JAK inhibitor I in 323 µL DMSO → 10 mM; aliquot 30 µL, store ≤6 months below –80 °C.
Resuspend 10 mg XAV939 in 1.6 mL DMSO → 20 mM; aliquot 20 µL, same storage.
Resuspend and filter 25 g VPA in 501 mL distilled water → 0.3 M; aliquot 30 µL.
Resuspend and filter 50 µg NRG1 in 500 µL 20 mM citrate pH 3.0 → 100 µg/mL; aliquot 20 µL.
Resuspend 10 mg Forskolin in 244 µL DMSO → 100 mM; aliquot 20 µL.

steps.title: Coat dishes with gelatin and plate MEFs
steps.instruction: Prepare gelatin‑coated 10 cm dishes and plate thawed MEF feeder cells.

substeps.instruction: Add 4 mL of 0.1 % gelatin solution to each 10 cm dish; incubate 10 min at room temperature.
Thaw a cryovial of MEFs 1–2 min in a 37 °C water bath.
Transfer cells to a 15 mL tube, add 5 mL MEF culture medium.
Centrifuge 1 300 rpm (330 g) 3 min; aspirate supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in MEF medium to 5.0 × 10⁴ cells/mL.
Aspirate gelatin solution from dishes and add 10 mL MEF suspension to each dish.

steps.title: Passage MEF feeder cells
steps.instruction: Expand MEFs to fresh gelatin‑coated dishes.

substeps.instruction: Incubate MEF dishes at 37 °C until subconfluent.
Wash dishes twice with PBS.
Add 1 mL trypsin; incubate 5–10 min at 37 °C.
Transfer detached cells to a 50 mL tube; add 5 × volume of MEF medium.
Centrifuge 1 300 rpm 3 min; aspirate supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in MEF medium.
Seed onto new gelatin‑coated 10 cm dishes at a 1:4–1:6 split ratio.

steps.title: Inactivate MEF feeder cells
steps.instruction: Irradiate MEFs and cryopreserve the inactivated feeder layer.

substeps.instruction: Harvest subconfluent MEFs with trypsin.
Resuspend cells in MEF medium to 1.0–5.0 × 10⁶ cells/mL.
Irradiate at 3 285 cGy/min for 40 min using a GAMMACELL 40 EXACTOR.
Centrifuge 1 300 rpm 3 min; aspirate supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in CELLBANKER 1 (ZENOGEN) at 2.0 × 10⁶ cells/mL.
Aliquot 500 µL into cryovials and store in liquid nitrogen.

steps.title: Thaw inactivated MEFs for PSC culture
steps.instruction: Prepare a gelatin‑coated 6‑well plate with thawed inactivated MEFs for use as feeder layer.

substeps.instruction: Thaw a cryovial of inactivated MEFs 1–2 min in a 37 °C water bath.
Transfer to a 15 mL tube and add 5 mL MEF culture medium.
Centrifuge 1 300 rpm 3 min; aspirate supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in MEF medium.
Seed 1.0 × 10⁶ cells per gelatin‑coated 6‑well plate.
Incubate overnight at 37 °C.

steps.title: Coat plates with Laminin‑E8
steps.instruction: Prepare Laminin‑E8‑coated wells for cytotrophoblast seeding.

substeps.instruction: Dilute 1.5 µg (3 µL) Laminin‑E8 in 1 mL PBS; mix by pipetting.
Add the Laminin‑E8/PBS solution to each well of a 6‑well plate.
Incubate at 37 °C for at least 30 min.

steps.title: Dissect and rinse chorionic villi
steps.instruction: Obtain villous tissue from placenta and clean it.

substeps.instruction: Manually separate human chorionic villi from chorionic membrane and decidua.
Cut villi into small pieces and transfer to a 50 mL tube.
Rinse fragments with 40 mL sterile PBS.
Centrifuge 800 rpm (120 g) 2 min; aspirate most supernatant.
Repeat rinse; shake vigorously until supernatant is clear.
Prepare digestion solution: 0.25 % Trypsin, 1 mg/mL Collagenase IV, 200 U/mL DNase, 25 mM HEPES, and DMEM/F‑12 medium.
Add tissue to the solution and agitate at 37 °C.
Perform three successive digestions.

steps.title: Filter and wash cell suspension
steps.instruction: Remove debris and wash the dissociated cells.

substeps.instruction: Pass pooled digests through a 70‑µm mesh filter (Corning).
Add 30 mL Wash medium; centrifuge 1 300 rpm 3 min.
Discard supernatant.

steps.title: Block non‑specific binding with BSA
steps.instruction: Incubate cells in BSA buffer to reduce background staining.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend pellet in 1 % BSA/HBSS; keep on ice 30 min.
Centrifuge 1 300 rpm 3 min; aspirate supernatant.

steps.title: Stain cells with primary antibodies
steps.instruction: Label cells with fluorophore‑conjugated antibodies against surface markers.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend cells in 1 % BSA/HBSS containing:
• Alexa Fluor 488‑conjugated anti‑TACSTD2,
• PE‑conjugated anti‑ENPEP,
• Biotin‑conjugated anti‑SIGLEC6.
Incubate 30 min at 4 °C.
Add 1 mL 1 % BSA/HBSS, centrifuge 1 300 rpm 3 min, aspirate.
Resuspend cells in 1 % BSA/HBSS with anti‑Streptavidin APC‑conjugated antibody.
Incubate 30 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Sort labeled trophoblast cells
steps.instruction: Isolate TACSTD2⁺ ENPEP⁺ SIGLEC6⁺ cells by flow cytometry.

substeps.instruction: Perform cell sorting at 4 °C; keep collection medium cold.
Collect sorted cells into ACE medium supplemented with 1 % Penicillin‑Streptomycin.
Maintain antimicrobial supplementation for at least 2 days.

steps.title: Recover and seed sorted cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge and plate the purified cytotrophoblasts.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge sorted cells 1 300 rpm 3 min; aspirate supernatant.
Resuspend in ACE medium + 1 % Pen‑Strep.
Seed onto Laminin‑E8‑coated wells at 4 × 10⁴ cells/cm².

steps.title: Maintain cultured cytotrophoblasts
steps.instruction: Culture primary cytotrophoblasts with regular feeding and passaging.

substeps.instruction: Replace medium every two days.
Passage every 3–6 days using Accutase for 10–15 min.
Seed at a 1:3–1:4 split ratio and add 10 µM Y‑27632 with each passage.
